title: Ratify idle-seat board-income policy (§3.2 dead-seat spirit) + EnterBoardMove dead-RNG-draw cleanup
description: Filed from the TASK-068 review (rev-t068 LOW-1 + LOW-3). LOW-1 (the substantive item, HUMAN decision): after TASK-068 wired BoardModel into the session FSM, an IDLE seat still accrues board tile income (MonedaPositiva, Propiedad rent, etc.) while it is correctly excluded from that round's MICROGAME reparto (TASK-056's idle-exclusion was scoped to microgame payouts only). rev-t068 judged this acceptable/out-of-scope for TASK-068 (no AC covered it; it does not violate coin conservation — income flows from the visible Bank) BUT flagged that passively farming board coins while idle is arguably counter to the GDD §3.2 dead-seat spirit (an abandoned/idle seat should not be rewarded). GATE: the human decides the intended GDD reading — either (a) idle seats are EXCLUDED from board tile income too (implement the exclusion in the BOARD_RESOLVE reconciliation, mirroring the microgame-reparto exclusion, with a test), or (b) board income for idle seats is INTENTIONAL (a small comeback/anti-snowball channel) and is documented as such. LOW-3 (trivial cleanup, fold in either way): EnterBoardMove derives a RngStream.Board RNG for BeginMovePhase that BoardModel deliberately ignores (accepted-but-unused per Annex D.2's signature + the no-bare-Random rule) — a harmless dead draw; optionally drop the derivation or comment it as an intentional signature-satisfying no-op. Read the TASK-068 reconciliation code (SessionStateMachine.EnterBoardMove/FinishBoardResolve/ApplyCoinFlows) + TASK-056 idle-exclusion + GDD §3.2/§5.6 before coding. Core/engine-free, fast-testable.
acceptance_criteria: HUMAN ratifies the idle-seat board-income policy: either (a) idle seats are excluded from board tile income (exclusion implemented in BOARD_RESOLVE reconciliation + regression test), or (b) idle-seat board income is documented as intentional anti-snowball design. The GDD §3.2 dead-seat spirit is honored either way
rev-t068 LOW-3 addressed: EnterBoardMove's dead RngStream.Board draw for the ignored BeginMovePhase rng is either removed or explicitly commented as an intentional signature-satisfying no-op
Coin conservation + determinism from TASK-068 remain intact (no coins created/destroyed, no balance negative); fast suite green, no regression
